name: Sample of Zanzil's Altered Mixture
summary: A courier carries Sample of Zanzil's Altered Mixture across the sea to Tarren Mill. The brew came from the witch doctor Zanzil and leaves its carrier weakened. Serge Hinott may find a cure and uncover the poison's workings.

sections.title: A Toxic Token
sections.body: An operative carries the mixture after infiltrating the Venture Company's tower near the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. The sample came from a cache in Gallywix's lockbox, and Zanzil's brew has left the agent afflicted. Shenthul sends the stricken operative across the Great Sea with the sample. At Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, apothecary Serge Hinott has the rare skill to isolate the toxin and learn its components.

sections.title: Secrets of Poisoncraft
sections.body: Serge Hinott studies the altered mixture to help the afflicted courier and reveal how to brew and handle potent poisons in the field. Horde rogues seek this knowledge to master the darker arts of their trade.

faq.answer: It is an alchemical brew tied to the witch doctor Zanzil, recovered from the Venture Company's tower near the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. Its potent toxin causes lingering, debilitating effects on anyone who touches it directly.

faq.q: Why do I need to take it to Serge Hinott?
faq.answer: Serge Hinott is an apothecary at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. His knowledge can neutralize the brew's effects and produce a reliable cure before the toxin causes permanent harm.

Zanzil the Outcast is a jungle troll witch doctor known for creating madness-inducing elixirs, poisons, and mutagens. His toxic recipes have spread beyond his native jungles into mercenary and industrial operations such as the Venture Company.

faq.q: How do you reach Tarren Mill to deliver it?
aliases: how to get to tarren mill
faq.answer: Take the zeppelin from Durotar to the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades. Then follow the main road south through Silverpine Forest and the signs east into the Hillsbrad Foothills to Tarren Mill.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you carry this dangerous sample to Serge Hinott, whose lessons cover brewing, handling, and applying lethal poisons.
As a Horde traveler, you carry the brew across a continent by zeppelin and road, following routes from Kalimdor to the Forsaken territories in Lordaeron.
